question: Who inaugurated the 44th Chess Olympiad, which was organised in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The 44th Chess Olympiad was inaugurated by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** in 2022.
 
• The event took place in **Chennai, Tamil Nadu**, marking the first time India hosted the Chess Olympiad.
 
• The opening ceremony was held on **July 28, 2022**, at the Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium in Chennai.
 
• The Chess Olympiad is a biennial event organized by the Fédé
